+// Hasher keeps a seed for each identifier. All instances share the same

+	mu    sync.Mutex

+func NewHasher() *Hasher {

+	}
 }
 
-// Reseed generates a new seed for the given id
-func (h *hasher) Reseed(id string) {
-	h.seeds[id] = maphash.MakeSeed()
+// SetSeed assigns a reproducible seed to the given identifier.
+func (h *Hasher) SetSeed(id, seed string) {
+	h.mu.Lock()
+	h.seeds[id] = seed
+	h.mu.Unlock()
 }
 
-// HashFunc returns a function that hashes a string using the seed for the given id
-func (h *hasher) HashFunc() func(id, str string) uint64 {
+// Reseed generates a new seed for the given identifier.
+func (h *Hasher) Reseed(id string) {
+	h.SetSeed(id, randomSeed())
+}
+
+// HashFunc returns a function that uses the current seed for each identifier.
+func (h *Hasher) HashFunc() func(id, str string) uint64 {
 	return func(id, str string) uint64 {
-		var hash maphash.Hash
-		var seed maphash.Seed
-		var ok bool
-		if seed, ok = h.seeds[id]; !ok {
-			seed = maphash.MakeSeed()
+		h.mu.Lock()
+		seed, ok := h.seeds[id]
+		if !ok {
+			seed = randomSeed()
 			h.seeds[id] = seed
 		}
-		hash.SetSeed(seed)
-		_, _ = hash.WriteString(str)
+		h.mu.Unlock()
+
+		var hash maphash.Hash
+		hash.SetSeed(h.seed)
+		writeString(&hash, id)
+		writeString(&hash, seed)
+		writeString(&hash, str)
 		return hash.Sum64()
 	}
 }
+
+func randomSeed() string {
+	var bytes [16]byte
+	if _, err := rand.Read(bytes[:]); err != nil {
+		panic(err)
+	}
+	return hex.EncodeToString(bytes[:])
+}
+
+func writeString(hash *maphash.Hash, value string) {
+	var length [8]byte
+	binary.LittleEndian.PutUint64(length[:], uint64(len(value)))
+	_, _ = hash.Write(length[:])
+	_, _ = hash.WriteString(value)
+}
